description: This is an SCSS stylesheet fragment defining styles for button groups, vertical button groups, toolbars, split buttons, and related UI components in a web project. It includes styling rules for layout, spacing, borders, border-radius, and interaction states.
external_files: variables and mixins files providing variables like $btn-border-radius, $btn-border-width, $btn-padding-x, and mixins like @include border-radius, @include border-end-radius, @include box-shadow
